manufacturing.basis: Giant does not state where this tire is made.

hookless_note: Giant's UK product page labels it 'Hookless compatible'; check the wheel maker's tire list and pressure limit.

availability.note: Sold by Giant's UK web store; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this model.

name: Gavia Course 0 Tubeless
positioning: Giant's premium tubeless road race tire with a 170 TPI casing, RR-S compound and Race Shield.
caveats: The UK store offers 28 and 30 mm, but its specification lists 25 and 28 mm.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price incl. UK VAT on 2026-11-01; one tire; delivery terms at checkout.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components review lists and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this exact model; shop and promotional posts, questions, mounting-only impressions, generic praise and reports about other models were left out. A commenter who may represent a shop is not counted.

reports.summary: After three months on a hookless wheelset: a dull road feel, poor value at the shop price and two cuts after the tire caught in a gravel gap.
Good value and long-lasting in the owner's riding.
Switched to the 30 mm and finds the ride much more comfortable.
Occasional punctures began after 5,000 km; still the owner's current tire.
Now the owner's only choice of stock tire: tough and long-lasting, and much lighter than the Course 1.

checks.note: Two posts plus two owners in a CADEX thread; a shop advert is not counted
